content: Typed by AUTOSAR data type vs. typed by C data type In contrast to the “C” typed PerInstanceMemory , the AUTOSAR-typed SwcInternal- Behavior.arTypedPerInstanceMemory is able to define information controlling the visibility in an MCD system via SwDataDefProps for the purpose of measure- ment, or for the purpose of defining an input value of an axis.
